{
  "name": "Settings",
  "type": "object",
  "description": "Estimator rate/setting key-value records, grouped by category. Drives the per-module estimator calculations and Settings pages.",
  "properties": {
    "setting_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Name of the setting"
    },
    "setting_value": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Value of the setting"
    },
    "setting_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "number",
        "text",
        "boolean"
      ],
      "description": "Type of the setting"
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Description of what this setting controls"
    },
    "category": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "labor",
        "pricing",
        "calculations",
        "general",
        "painting_pricing",
        "painting_labor",
        "painting_supplies",
        "laser_rates",
        "laser_labor",
        "laser_calc",
        "laser_material",
        "laser_speed",
        "laser_calculator",
        "shared_calculator",
        "cnc_rates",
        "cnc_labor",
        "cnc_calc",
        "cnc_material",
        "cnc_speed",
        "metal_rates",
        "metal_labor",
        "metal_calc",
        "metal_material",
        "install_pricing",
        "install_rates",
        "install_multipliers",
        "foundation_pricing",
        "foundation_labor",
        "foundation_calc",
        "brick_stone_pricing",
        "brick_stone_labor",
        "brick_stone_calc",
        "vinyl_pricing",
        "vinyl_labor",
        "vinyl_calc",
        "maintenance_pricing",
        "maintenance_labor"
      ],
      "description": "Category of the setting"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "setting_name",
    "setting_value",
    "setting_type"
  ],
  "rls": {
    "create": { "user_condition": { "role": "__settings_backend_only__" } },
    "read": { "user_condition": { "role": "__settings_backend_only__" } },
    "update": { "user_condition": { "role": "__settings_backend_only__" } },
    "delete": { "user_condition": { "role": "__settings_backend_only__" } }
  }
}
